pages.text: Homes stay simple. The builds that make a city breathe are its $(thing)shared works$(0): halls, taverns, libraries, shrines, plazas, workshops and the yards where jobs are done. Many citizens use them at once, so as your population grows you raise more of them.$(br2)Each culture dresses them in its own materials. Pick your culture to see its buildings:

$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_temperate/buildings)Temperate$(0)$(br)$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_subarctic/buildings)Subarctic$(0)$(br)$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_desert/buildings)Desert$(0)$(br)$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_tropical/buildings)Tropical$(0)$(br)$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_steppe/buildings)Steppe$(0)$(br)$(li)$(l:tfc:materialism_society_mountain/buildings)Mountain$(0)$(br2)Farms, quarries and pastures are the same everywhere: see $(l:tfc:materialism_society/shared_workplaces)Shared Workplaces$(0).
